findings.commitment: Real-time scoring of 750,000 outbound instant payments per day by end of first year

promise_quotes.quote: Real-time scoring will handle up to 750,000 payments per day by the end of the first year.

findings.reason: The catalogue caps real-time transaction monitoring in AU at 500,000 transactions per day, and the pricing note confirms no approval exists for the 750,000/day volume promised for year one.

findings.commitment: Real-time scoring of 750,000 outbound instant payments per day by end of first year

promise_quotes.quote: Real-time scoring will handle up to 750,000 payments per day by the end of the first year.

findings.reason: The SOW and contract only commit to 200,000 payments per day at launch and say nothing about scaling to 750,000 per day by year end, so this capacity promise has no contractual backing.

findings.commitment: All outbound instant payments scored in real time before release

promise_quotes.quote: All outbound instant payments will be scored in real time before they are released, from the 1 February 2027 launch.

contract_quote.quote: Outbound instant payments below AUD 1,000 are scored in batches at hourly intervals after release.

findings.subject: instant payments
findings.promised_value: All outbound instant payments scored in real time before release, with no exceptions
findings.contract_value: Payments below AUD 1,000 are scored in hourly batches after release, not in real time before release
findings.reason: Elva promised that every outbound instant payment would be checked in real time before release, but the incorporated SOW Annex A only does this for payments of AUD 1,000 or more, leaving smaller payments scored after the money has already left — exactly the scam pattern the deal was sold to stop.

findings.commitment: BioCatch-based coaching detection live from 1 February 2027 launch

promise_quotes.quote: Through its connector to BioCatch, Elva will use behavioural signals from Alder's mobile and internet banking to flag customers who appear to be coached by a scammer, live from the 1 February 2027 launch.
Behavioural signals from BioCatch will flag customers who appear to be coached by a scammer, from the 1 February 2027 launch.

note_quote.quote: No named exception approved for Alder Bank

findings.reason: CAP-027 is in beta and requires a named approval before it can be sold, but the pricing note records no named approver for Alder Bank, so this promise of live coaching detection at launch is not yet authorised.

findings.commitment: Hosting Alder's environment on Microsoft Azure in Australia East

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will host Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

findings.reason: The catalogue only supports AWS or GCP for regional cloud deployment in Australia; Microsoft Azure is not an offered cloud and cannot be sold even with an exception.

findings.commitment: Hosting Alder's environment on Microsoft Azure in Australia East

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will host Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

contract_quote.quote: Provider will host the Customer's dedicated environment on Amazon Web Services in the Sydney region.

findings.subject: dedicated environment
findings.promised_value: Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region
findings.contract_value: Amazon Web Services in the Sydney region
findings.reason: Elva's RFP response promised hosting on Microsoft Azure in Australia East, but the incorporated SOW instead commits to Amazon Web Services in the Sydney region — a direct conflict on cloud provider that Alder flagged as important to them.
